answer.evidence: Transmitter output degraded: measured A-TX -1.84 dBm now, down from ~1.8 dBm average historically, with daily TX power avg -1.21 dBm on 2026-10-26. Received power at B fell correspondingly to -14.6 dBm at B-RX and daily RX avg -14.1 dBm, triggering RX_LOW_WARNING. Fibre plant loss unchanged: B-ODF -9.5 dBm with A-TX -1.84 dBm gives ~7.66 dB link loss vs commissioning 7.61 dB, OTDR shows no new loss events and connectors are clean.

A-TX output 0.81 dBm and B-ODF -7.4 dBm give fibre loss 8.21 dB vs commissioning 5.41 dB. OTDR at 1550 nm from A shows 2.92 dB reflective loss at 23.15 km at B-ODF. Embedded OTDR shows 2.95 dB loss at 23.152 km. Connector inspection at B-ODF shows contamination; patching at site B ODF occurred 2026-10-23 11:43 UTC just before alarm. Attenuator loss B-ODF to B-RX is ~7.1 dB, matching design 7 dB.

RX power dropped ~3.5 dB after patching work at MID-PP on 2026-10-25. Power measurement shows excess link loss 12.72 dB vs commissioning 9.32 dB. OTDR from A shows reflective loss 3.72 dB at 26.067 km matching MID-PP location. Connector inspection shows scratches across core at MID-PP. Attenuator verified correct.

Link loss increased from commissioning 4.72 dB to measured 7.58 dB (A-TX 1.2 dBm to B-ODF -6.38 dBm). RX power dropped after 22 Oct with RX_LOW_WARNING active since 2026-10-22 23:00 UTC. Site notes show SC-05 re-entered 2026-10-22 22:33 UTC. OTDR 1550 nm from A shows non-reflective loss 2.59 dB at 18.753 km, matching SC-05 location at route km 18.254. The loss event is also seen from B. Connectors clean, attenuator nominal. Root cause is bad splice at SC-05 introduced during re-entry.

evidence_refs.quote: "time": "2026-10-22 22:33 UTC", "entry": "Splicing crew re-entered closure SC-05 to add a branch cable for a new customer. Closure resealed."

answer.evidence: Link loss increased from commissioning 3.39 dB to measured 4.71 dB (A-TX 1.41 dBm to B-ODF -3.3 dBm). RX power dropped ~1.3 dB on 2026-10-24 coinciding with SC-03 re-entry for branch addition. OTDR at 1550 nm from A shows non-reflective loss 1.33 dB at 10.99 km, consistent with SC-03 at 10.723 km. Connectors clean and attenuator loss normal at ~10 dB.

OTDR at 1550 nm from A shows fibre end at 18.203 km and from B shows fibre end at 13.159 km. Using the as-built splice mapping (SC-03 route 13.668 km corresponds to fibre 14.057 km, ratio ~1.0285), the fibre distances convert to ~17.7 km route from A, placing the break between SC-03 (13.668 km) and SC-04 (19.484 km). No light is measured at B-ODF and RX, and power at A-TX is normal, confirming a physical break. Site notes report heavy rain near km18 and road works near km20 on the failure date.

Fibre plant loss is normal: A-TX 0.93 dBm to B-ODF -11.12 dBm = 12.05 dB, essentially equal to commissioning loss 12.12 dB. Power at B-RX is -21.28 dBm, ~10.16 dB lower than B-ODF, indicating excess loss after the ODF. Site notes show receiver replaced and attenuator refitted from spares box on 2026-10-19 12:22 UTC, the same time as RX_LOW_ALARM and BER degradation began. Design attenuator is 0 dB, so a non-zero attenuator was installed.

evidence_refs.quote: "B-ATT": "fixed in-line attenuator at site B between ODF and receiver, design value 0 dB"
"entry": "Receiver module at site B replaced under RMA. Attenuator refitted from spares box."
